title: Stainless Steel Vacuum Flasks / Insulated Water Bottles - Specification

amendments.summary: Updated permissible food-grade stainless steel austenitic grades (SS 304 / SS 316) and laser marking guidelines.

characteristics: Food contact austenitic stainless steel material (Grade SS 304 / SS 316 / IS 6911)
Double-walled vacuum thermal insulation
Nominal liquid holding capacity from 250 ml to 2000 ml
Leak-proof cap with food-grade silicone gasket
intended_use: Safe storage and thermal temperature retention of drinking water and potable beverages
Domestic and outdoor hydration

key_clauses.title: Material of Construction & Food Grade Steel
key_clauses.requirement_text: Inner body and outer casing in contact with beverage shall be manufactured from austenitic stainless steel Grade X04Cr19Ni9 (SS 304) or X02Cr17Ni12Mo2 (SS 316) conforming to IS 6911. Heavy metal extraction test (Lead < 0.01 mg/kg, Cadmium < 0.005 mg/kg) must comply with IS 9845.
key_clauses.test_method: Spectrometric chemical analysis conforming to IS 228 and Overall Migration Test under IS 9845
key_clauses.required_evidence: Raw material Mill Test Certificate (MTC) + NABL Spectrometry Chemical Composition Report

key_clauses.title: Thermal Insulation Retention Test
key_clauses.requirement_text: The vacuum flask filled with boiling water (min 95°C) and sealed at ambient temperature (27±2°C) shall retain minimum temperature of 60°C after 6 hours for small flasks (<500ml) and minimum 65°C after 6 hours for flasks >750ml.
key_clauses.test_method: Calibrated thermal sensor immersion test in controlled climatic chamber over 6-hour interval
key_clauses.required_evidence: In-house / NABL Calibrated Thermal Insulation Retention Test Report

key_clauses.title: Leakage & Inversion Pressure Resistance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Flask filled to rated capacity with liquid, capped tightly, and inverted for 30 minutes at room temperature and subjected to 20 kPa internal pressure must show zero liquid seepage or gasket deformation.
key_clauses.test_method: Inversion leak test bench with hydrostatic air pressure gauge
key_clauses.required_evidence: Leakage and pressure tightness test log sheet

key_clauses.title: Drop Impact and Handle Dynamic Strength
key_clauses.requirement_text: Filled bottle dropped from a height of 1.0 meter onto hardwood floor in 3 orientations (base, cap, side) shall show no rupture, vacuum loss, or leakage.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard drop tester apparatus (1.0m height)
key_clauses.required_evidence: Drop test observation report and vacuum post-drop verification

key_clauses.title: Marking, Capacity Stamping & ISI License Layout
key_clauses.requirement_text: Every bottle must be permanently laser-etched on base with: 1. Manufacturer Name / Trademark, 2. Nominal Capacity in ml, 3. Steel Grade (e.g., SUS 304), 4. Standard Mark (ISI Logo) with CM/L License Number.
key_clauses.test_method: Visual and abrasion resistance inspection of laser etching
key_clauses.required_evidence: Artwork approval sheet & sample laser etching photo with CM/L number

title: Domestic Stainless Steel Single-Walled Water Bottles - Specification
characteristics: Single-walled non-insulated stainless steel construction
Direct liquid contact SS 304 / SS 201 food-grade sheet
Thickness not less than 0.5 mm
intended_use: Domestic water storage, refrigerator bottle, and general ambient liquid holding

key_clauses.title: Sheet Thickness and Stainless Steel Grade
key_clauses.requirement_text: Minimum wall thickness shall be 0.50 mm throughout body. Material must be food contact compliant austenitic steel with Nickel > 8.0% and Chromium > 18.0%.
key_clauses.test_method: Ultrasonic / digital micrometric thickness gauge and XRF spectrometry
key_clauses.required_evidence: Raw material chemical & dimensional inspection report

key_clauses.title: Corrosion Resistance Salt Spray Test
key_clauses.requirement_text: Bottle interior exposed to 5% neutral sodium chloride salt spray test for 24 hours shall show no signs of pitting, discoloration, or rust formation.
key_clauses.test_method: Salt spray chamber conforming to IS 9000 (Part 11)
key_clauses.required_evidence: 24-hour Salt Spray Corrosion Resistance Test Certificate

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Appliances for Heating Liquids (Electric Kettles)

amendments.summary: Mandated cordless kettle connector endurance testing (10,000 cycles) and bimetal thermal protector fail-safe response.

characteristics: Rated voltage up to 250V AC single phase
Rated wattage 500W to 2200W
Heating element with concealed or immersion base
Automatic shut-off and boil-dry safety switch
intended_use: Boiling water and heating potable liquids for household preparation

key_clauses.title: Marking, Rating Label & ISI License Stamping
key_clauses.requirement_text: Kettles shall be permanently marked with rated voltage (230V AC), rated power (W), model identifier, water level MAX indicator, and ISI mark with CML license number.
key_clauses.test_method: Rubbing test with water and petroleum spirit for 15 seconds
key_clauses.required_evidence: Approved rating plate artwork with CM/L number

key_clauses.title: Leakage Current & Dielectric Strength at Operating Temperature
key_clauses.requirement_text: Leakage current under operating temperature shall not exceed 0.75 mA for Class I portable appliances. High voltage insulation must withstand 1000V AC for 1 minute without breakdown.
key_clauses.test_method: Calibrated leakage current meter and High Voltage Dielectric breakdown tester
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Electrical Type Test Report covering Clause 13 & 16

key_clauses.title: Abnormal Operation and Boil-Dry Protection
key_clauses.requirement_text: Kettles energized without water at 1.15 times rated power input must trigger automatic thermal cut-out before vessel temperature exceeds 200°C, with zero flame or molten material risk.
key_clauses.test_method: Dry boil abnormal operation test chamber with thermocouple logging
key_clauses.required_evidence: Thermal cut-out response log & boil-dry safety test certificate

key_clauses.title: Cordless Kettle Base Interlock and Pin Endurance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Base contacts must endure 10,000 insertion and withdrawal cycles under electrical load without excessive contact resistance or pin deformation.
key_clauses.test_method: Automated mechanical endurance cycling machine at 10 cycles/min
key_clauses.required_evidence: 10,000-cycle connector endurance test report

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements

amendments.summary: Harmonized earth continuity testing and glow-wire flammability test for polymer enclosures.

characteristics: Single phase AC up to 250V, three phase up to 415V
Class I (Earthed) and Class II (Double Insulated) electrical architecture
intended_use: Base electrical safety framework for all domestic and commercial appliances

key_clauses.title: Protection Against Access to Live Parts
key_clauses.requirement_text: Live parts shall not be accessible to standard jointed test finger probe (Test Probe B of IS 1401) in all operating positions.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard articulated test probe inspection with 20N force
key_clauses.required_evidence: IP2X access verification test sheet

key_clauses.title: Supply Connection and Flexible Power Cord
key_clauses.requirement_text: Supply power cord must comply with IS 694 with green/yellow earth core. Cord anchorage must withstand 25 pulls of 60N with zero longitudinal displacement exceeding 2mm.
key_clauses.test_method: Cord pull and torque testing machine
key_clauses.required_evidence: IS 694 cable conformity certificate + cord anchorage test report

title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders Exceeding 5 Litre Water Capacity for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases (LPG Cylinders)
status: Current / Mandatory under Gas Cylinder Rules & QCO

amendments.summary: Mandated automated ultrasonic longitudinal weld inspection and standardized tare weight tolerance (+/- 100g).

characteristics: Welded low carbon steel sheet conforming to IS 6240
Water capacity from 5 Litres to 130 Litres
Designed for propane, butane, and LPG mixtures
intended_use: Storage, transportation, and domestic/commercial distribution of LPG

key_clauses.title: Steel Chemistry & Mechanical Properties
key_clauses.requirement_text: Steel sheets must comply with IS 6240 Grade 1. Carbon max 0.16%, Manganese 0.30-0.80%, Sulphur & Phosphorus max 0.035% each. Tensile strength min 350-450 MPa with min 25% elongation.
key_clauses.test_method: Chemical spectrometry and tensile testing machine under IS 1608
key_clauses.required_evidence: IS 6240 Steel Raw Material Test Certificate + Spectrometer Log

key_clauses.title: Hydrostatic Proof Pressure & Volumetric Expansion Test
key_clauses.requirement_text: Every cylinder manufactured shall undergo 100% hydrostatic proof pressure testing at 2.45 MPa (25 kgf/cm2) with zero leakage. Permanent volumetric expansion must not exceed 10% of total expansion.
key_clauses.test_method: Water jacket hydrostatic test installation with digital manometer
key_clauses.required_evidence: Batch Hydrostatic Test Record Log signed by Quality Inspector

key_clauses.title: Bursting Pressure Test (Destructive Batch Sampling)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Sample cylinder selected from each heat lot of 200 units must burst at pressure not less than 4.90 MPa without steel fragmentation.
key_clauses.test_method: High-pressure hydraulic burst chamber
key_clauses.required_evidence: Destructive Burst Pressure Test Report with pressure curve graph

key_clauses.title: Collar Stamping, Tare Weight & Permanent ISI Mark
key_clauses.requirement_text: Collar shroud must be stamped with test pressure (2.45 MPa), water capacity (L), tare weight (kg), manufacturer mark, PESO approval number, and ISI mark with CML number.
key_clauses.test_method: Visual inspection and die-stamping verification
key_clauses.required_evidence: Approved collar stamping layout and tare scale calibration report

title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases - Cylinders for Liquefiable Gases Other than LPG
characteristics: Welded low carbon steel for non-LPG low pressure gases (fluorocarbons, sulfur dioxide, methyl chloride)
intended_use: Containment and transport of specialized industrial refrigerant and chemical gases

key_clauses.title: Design Wall Thickness and Corrosion Allowance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Wall thickness calculated based on maximum developed pressure at 65°C with additional 1.0 mm corrosion allowance for non-toxic industrial refrigerants.
key_clauses.test_method: Ultrasonic thickness measurement
key_clauses.required_evidence: Design calculation sheet and ultrasonic thickness log

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
status: Current / Mandatory under FSSAI & BIS Act

amendments.summary: Mandated pesticide residue limits (< 0.0001 mg/L) and radio-nucleotide testing.

characteristics: Water treated by decantation, filtration, RO, demineralization, ozonation, or UV
Packaged in hermetically sealed food-grade containers
intended_use: Direct human consumption and commercial retail potable hydration

key_clauses.title: Physical and Chemical Quality Parameters
key_clauses.requirement_text: TDS max 500 mg/L, pH 6.5 to 8.5, Turbidity max 2 NTU, Total Hardness max 200 mg/L, Chlorides max 200 mg/L, Heavy metals: Lead max 0.01 mg/L, Arsenic max 0.01 mg/L.
key_clauses.test_method: AAS/ICP-MS spectrometry and standard chemical titration under IS 3025
key_clauses.required_evidence: Complete Chemical Analysis Report from NABL / BIS In-house Laboratory

key_clauses.title: Microbiological Sterility Parameters
key_clauses.requirement_text: Escherichia coli, Total Coliforms, Faecal Streptococci, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa must be absent in 250 ml sample. Yeast and mould count must be zero.
key_clauses.test_method: Membrane filtration method under IS 15185 / IS 5403
key_clauses.required_evidence: Daily Microbiological In-house Laboratory Culture Incubation Log

key_clauses.title: Food Grade Packaging in IS 15410 PET Containers
key_clauses.requirement_text: Bottles must conform to IS 15410. Labels must declare: 1. Brand Name, 2. Net Volume, 3. Batch No, 4. Date of Packing, 5. 'CRUSH THE BOTTLE AFTER USE', 6. ISI Standard Mark with CML number and FSSAI License Number.
key_clauses.test_method: Migration testing under IS 9845 and artwork verification
key_clauses.required_evidence: Bottle packaging certificate under IS 15410 + Approved Label Artwork

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water - Specification
characteristics: Obtained directly from natural or drilled underground springs with natural mineral content, packaged at source
intended_use: Natural mineral drinking water consumption without chemical remineralization

key_clauses.title: Origin and Protection of Underground Water Source
key_clauses.requirement_text: Source must be an underground water-bearing strata accessed through a natural spring or borehole protected against surface contamination. Total Dissolved Solids naturally present between 150 mg/L and 700 mg/L.
key_clauses.test_method: Hydrogeological source inspection report and full spectrum mineral assay
key_clauses.required_evidence: Geological Survey & Source Hydro-Chemical Purity Certificate

title: Containers for Packaging of Natural Mineral Water and Packaged Drinking Water - Specification
characteristics: Rigid/semi-rigid virgin plastic container (PET, Polycarbonate, Polypropylene)
Food contact certified under IS 10146
intended_use: Direct packaging and preservation of bottled drinking water

key_clauses.title: Raw Material Grade & Overall Migration Limit
key_clauses.requirement_text: Must use 100% virgin food grade polymer. Overall migration limit shall not exceed 60 mg/kg or 10 mg/dm2 when tested in distilled water and 3% acetic acid simulant.
key_clauses.test_method: Overall migration extraction testing under IS 9845
key_clauses.required_evidence: Virgin Polymer Certificate + Migration Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Drop Impact and Top Load Axial Resistance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Filled containers dropped from 1.2m onto smooth concrete must not rupture or leak. Top load vertical compression strength must withstand min 150 N.
key_clauses.test_method: Top load compression tester and drop test jig
key_clauses.required_evidence: Top load & drop impact testing verification report

title: Safety of Toys - Part 1: Mechanical and Physical Properties
status: Current / Mandatory under Toys Quality Control Order

amendments.summary: Updated expanding materials requirements and projectile toy kinetic energy limits (< 0.08 J).

characteristics: Intended for play by children under 14 years of age
Plastic, metal, textile, or composite construction
intended_use: Recreation, learning, and play for infants and children

key_clauses.title: Small Parts Choking Hazard for Under 36 Months
key_clauses.requirement_text: Toys for children under 3 years must not detach or contain components fitting entirely inside the small parts cylinder (31.7 mm diameter x 57.1 mm depth).
key_clauses.test_method: Small parts test fixture gauge under 4.45N force
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Small Parts Choking Hazard Test Report

key_clauses.title: Accessible Sharp Edges and Sharp Points
key_clauses.requirement_text: Accessible edges and points must be hemmed or covered. Must not cut PTFE tape on sharp edge tester or actuate sharp point indicator probe.
key_clauses.test_method: Sharp edge tester (UL 1439) and sharp point tester
key_clauses.required_evidence: Sharp edges and points inspection log

key_clauses.title: Mandatory Age Grading Warnings & ISI Marking
key_clauses.requirement_text: Packaging must bear: 1. Minimum age icon (e.g. 0-3 circle slash), 2. Specific hazard statement, 3. Manufacturer address, 4. ISI Standard Mark with CML license.
key_clauses.test_method: Label inspection and legibility assessment
key_clauses.required_evidence: Approved packaging artwork and Scheme-I License certificate

title: Safety of Toys - Part 2: Flammability Requirements
characteristics: Flammability rate of textile, pile fabric, or hair material in toys
intended_use: Fire safety and prevention of rapid flame spread in children play costumes and stuffed toys

key_clauses.title: Maximum Rate of Flame Spread for Pile Fabrics
key_clauses.requirement_text: Flammability rate of soft stuffed toys and fabric costumes shall not exceed 30 mm/s when subjected to standard micro-burner ignition flame for 3 seconds.
key_clauses.test_method: Flammability test cabinet with timed optical sensors
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Toy Flammability Flame Spread Report

title: Safety of Toys - Part 3: Migration of Certain Heavy Elements
characteristics: Surface coatings, polymers, and pliable materials accessible to mouthing
intended_use: Prevention of heavy metal toxicity and ingestion in children

key_clauses.title: Element Migration Limits for Heavy Metals
key_clauses.requirement_text: Maximum elemental migration limits (mg/kg): Lead 90 (23 for modelling clay), Cadmium 75, Arsenic 25, Antimony 60, Barium 1000, Chromium 60, Mercury 60, Selenium 500.
key_clauses.test_method: Hydrochloric acid (0.07 M) extraction and ICP-OES / AAS analysis
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Heavy Elements Migration Test Certificate

title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Platings - Purity and Hallmarking - Specification

amendments.summary: Mandated 6-digit alphanumeric Hallmarking Unique Identification (HUID) laser marking.

characteristics: Gold content declared in Karats (24K, 22K, 18K, 14K) and parts per thousand fineness (999, 916, 750, 585)
intended_use: Consumer gold retail sale and financial jewellery transactions

key_clauses.title: Recognized Fineness Grades and Zero Negative Tolerance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Standard grades: 24K (999/995), 22K (916), 20K (833), 18K (750), 14K (585), 9K (375). Zero negative tolerance permitted against declared fineness grade.
key_clauses.test_method: Fire Assay method conforming to IS 1418 and XRF preliminary screening
key_clauses.required_evidence: Assaying & Hallmarking Centre (AHC) Fire Assay Test Report

key_clauses.title: Tripartite Hallmark Laser Etching & 6-Digit HUID
key_clauses.requirement_text: Mandatory three marks: 1. BIS Triangular Logo, 2. Purity in Karat and Fineness (e.g. 22K916), 3. 6-digit alphanumeric Hallmarking Unique Identification (HUID).
key_clauses.test_method: Microscopic visual inspection and BIS e-Manak HUID database verification
key_clauses.required_evidence: BIS Recognized AHC Hallmarking Certificate with HUID Number

title: Silver and Silver Alloys, Platings - Purity and Hallmarking - Specification
characteristics: Silver purity fineness declared in parts per thousand (999, 925 Sterling Silver, 900, 800)
intended_use: Retail silver jewellery, utensils, and bullion sale

key_clauses.title: Silver Fineness Grades & Assay Determination
key_clauses.requirement_text: Fineness grades: 999 (fine silver), 970, 925 (sterling), 900, 835, 800. Purity determined via potentiometric titration conforming to IS 2113.
key_clauses.test_method: Potentiometric titration and gravimetric silver analysis
key_clauses.required_evidence: AHC Silver Purity Assay Certificate

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes (Lithium Systems)
status: Current / Mandatory under Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
characteristics: Rechargeable lithium and lithium-ion secondary cells and battery packs
intended_use: Portable electronic appliances, computers, and consumer devices

key_clauses.title: Continuous Charging and External Short Circuit Test
key_clauses.requirement_text: Fully charged cells charged at specified current for 28 days must exhibit no fire, explosion, or leakage. External short circuit test at 55°C must not result in flame.
key_clauses.test_method: 28-day continuous charging rack and 55°C short circuit chamber (<80 mOhm)
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Electrical Battery Safety Test Report under CRS Scheme-II

key_clauses.title: Thermal Abuse and Mechanical Shock Resistance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Cells held in gravity convection oven at 130°C for 10 minutes must not explode or ignite. Free fall drop test from 1.0m on concrete must maintain casing integrity.
key_clauses.test_method: 130°C thermal abuse chamber and drop test apparatus
key_clauses.required_evidence: Thermal abuse test log with temperature thermocouple profile

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to 250V and Rated Current up to 16A - Specification
characteristics: 2-pin and 3-pin plugs/sockets rated for 6A, 10A, and 16A at 250V AC
intended_use: Electrical mains power connection in residential and commercial installations

key_clauses.title: Dimensional Verification & Earth Pin First-Make Last-Break
key_clauses.requirement_text: Pin dimensions must conform to standard go/no-go gauges. The earth pin must engage before current-carrying live and neutral pins make contact and break last.
key_clauses.test_method: Calibrated precision plug gauge set
key_clauses.required_evidence: Dimensional inspection gauge sheet

key_clauses.title: Temperature Rise Test Under Rated Current
key_clauses.requirement_text: Terminals carrying 1.1 times rated current (17.6A for 16A rating) shall not exceed temperature rise of 45 K above ambient.
key_clauses.test_method: Thermocouple continuous current loading bench for 1 hour
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Temperature Rise Test Certificate

title: Ordinary Portland Cement (33 Grade, 43 Grade and 53 Grade) - Specification

amendments.summary: Revised chloride content limits (< 0.05%) for pre-stressed concrete applications.

characteristics: Hydraulic binder composed of synthetic calcium silicates
intended_use: Reinforced concrete structures, bridges, pavements, and building construction

key_clauses.title: Chemical Composition Limits (LSF, Insoluble Residue, Magnesia)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Lime Saturation Factor (LSF) 0.66 to 1.02, Insoluble residue max 5.0%, Magnesia max 6.0%, Total Loss on Ignition max 5.0%, Total Sulfur as SO3 max 3.5%.
key_clauses.test_method: Chemical wet analysis under IS 4032
key_clauses.required_evidence: Daily Chemical Quality Control Log + NABL Cement Test Report

key_clauses.title: Compressive Strength & Setting Time
key_clauses.requirement_text: Initial setting time min 30 min, Final setting time max 600 min. 28-Day Compressive Strength: 33 Grade >= 33 MPa, 43 Grade >= 43 MPa, 53 Grade >= 53 MPa.
key_clauses.test_method: Vicat apparatus for setting time and hydraulic compression testing under IS 4031
key_clauses.required_evidence: 28-Day Mortar Cube Compressive Strength Record Sheet

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification (TMT Steel)

amendments.summary: Introduced Fe 550D, Fe 600, and Fe 650 grades with high elongation ductility.

characteristics: Thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) deformed carbon steel rebar (Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550D)
intended_use: Tensile reinforcement in earthquake-resistant RCC buildings, bridges, and infrastructure

key_clauses.title: Carbon Equivalent & Chemical Composition
key_clauses.requirement_text: Carbon Equivalent (CE) max 0.42% for Fe 500D grade. Sulfur & Phosphorus max 0.040% each to ensure superior weldability and ductility.
key_clauses.test_method: Emission spectrometry under IS 8811
key_clauses.required_evidence: Heat Ladle Chemical Analysis Mill Certificate

key_clauses.title: Proof Stress, Tensile Strength and Minimum Elongation
key_clauses.requirement_text: 0.2% Proof Stress min 500 MPa. Tensile strength / yield ratio min 1.10. Total elongation at maximum force min 5.0% (min 16% gauge elongation for 500D).
key_clauses.test_method: Universal Testing Machine (UTM) tensile pull under IS 1608
key_clauses.required_evidence: UTM Tensile Stress-Strain Graph Record

title: Protective Helmets for Two Wheeler Riders - Specification
status: Current / Mandatory under Motor Vehicles Act & QCO

amendments.summary: Weight limit capped at 1.2 kg and revised peripheral vision field of view.

characteristics: Hard protective shell (ABS / Polycarbonate), impact absorbing EPS liner, retention chinstrap, and visor
intended_use: Head protection and crash injury prevention for motorized two-wheeler riders

key_clauses.title: Impact Attenuation & Headform Peak Deceleration
key_clauses.requirement_text: Helmet dropped onto flat and hemispherical steel anvils at 7.5 m/s. Peak headform deceleration shall not exceed 300g and duration of 150g must not exceed 5 ms.
key_clauses.test_method: Guided free-fall monorail impact rig with tri-axial accelerometer
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Impact Attenuation Dynamic Sensor Graph Report

key_clauses.title: Retention System (Chinstrap) Dynamic Strength
key_clauses.requirement_text: Chinstrap subjected to dynamic drop mass. Dynamic displacement shall not exceed 35 mm and residual elongation shall not exceed 25 mm.
key_clauses.test_method: Dynamic retention drop tester with 10 kg drop weight
key_clauses.required_evidence: Chinstrap elongation and release buckle test report

title: Medical Face Masks - Specification
characteristics: Spunbond-Meltblown-Spunbond (SMS) nonwoven polypropylene with nose clip and ear loops
intended_use: Barrier protection against infectious droplets and airborne microbial transmission

key_clauses.title: Bacterial Filtration Efficiency (BFE) >= 98%
key_clauses.requirement_text: BFE tested with aerosolized Staphylococcus aureus shall be minimum 95% for Class 1 and minimum 98% for Class 2 & 3 surgical masks.
key_clauses.test_method: Anderson 6-stage biological aerosol sampler under ASTM F2101
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Bacterial Filtration Biological Laboratory Certificate

key_clauses.title: Differential Pressure (Breathability Delta P) and Splash Resistance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Differential pressure must be less than 40 Pa/cm2 for comfortable breathability. Synthetic blood fluid resistance minimum 120 mmHg for surgical protection.
key_clauses.test_method: Differential manometer airflow bench and pressurized synthetic blood nozzle
key_clauses.required_evidence: Breathability Delta P and Fluid Splash Test Log

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
status: Current / Mandatory under MNRE Quality Control Order

amendments.summary: Mandated PID (Potential Induced Degradation) testing and revised bypass diode thermal runaway verification.

characteristics: Tempered solar glass, EVA encapsulant, crystalline silicon cells, Tedlar backsheet, anodized aluminum frame
intended_use: Direct conversion of solar irradiance into electrical power in terrestrial grid-tied and off-grid installations

key_clauses.title: Electrical Performance at Standard Test Conditions (STC)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Peak maximum power (Pmax), open circuit voltage (Voc), and short circuit current (Isc) measured under 1000 W/m2 irradiance, AM 1.5 spectrum at 25°C cell temperature.
key_clauses.test_method: Class AAA Xenon Flash Sun Simulator conforming to IEC 60904
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Flash Tester Calibration Curve & Power Output Matrix

key_clauses.title: Thermal Cycling (200 Cycles -40°C to +85°C) & Damp Heat (1000 Hours)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Module subjected to 200 thermal cycles between -40°C and +85°C with current injection, followed by 1000 hours at 85°C / 85% RH. Power degradation must not exceed 5%.
key_clauses.test_method: Walk-in environmental climatic simulation chamber with continuous IV curve monitoring
key_clauses.required_evidence: 200-cycle Thermal & Damp Heat Environmental Aging Report

key_clauses.title: Mechanical Load Test (5400 Pa Wind & Snow Load)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Module mounted on frame subjected to dynamic pneumatic pressure load of 5400 Pa (front face snow load) and 2400 Pa (rear face wind suction) with zero cell micro-cracking.
key_clauses.test_method: Automated mechanical load test rig with suction pads
key_clauses.required_evidence: 5400 Pa Mechanical Load & Post-EL Electroluminescence Image
